name: modal
title: Modal flows: confirm and edit in a dialog
description: Two dialog components on the kit <Dialog> (native modal: focus moves in, the page is inert, Escape closes): comp/confirm-dialog (trigger button, message, Cancel/Confirm, danger style, emits confirm) and comp/rename-dialog (a form() inside a dialog: validation, busy state, server errors under the field, closes on success). views/team.brain uses both on a list of members.
notes: Open a dialog from code with expose: <ConfirmDialog bind:api={d} /> then d.open(). Tests pass emit handlers as props named 'on:<event>'. Link /team from the nav.
